citations.title: Stephen J. Hemsley

sentences.text: Stephen J. Hemsley has been chief executive officer of UnitedHealth Group (NYSE: UNH) since May 13, 2025, when he was appointed effective immediately following Andrew Witty's decision to step down for personal reasons, while remaining chairman of the board.

sentences.quote: He previously served as the company's CEO from 2006 to 2017, after joining the company as chief operating officer in 1997 and becoming president in 1999. He has been a member of the company's Board since 2000.
sentences.text: He joined the company as chief operating officer in 1997, became president in 1999, and has served on the board since 2000, serving as CEO from 2006 to 2017 and as board chair since September 2017.
Before UnitedHealth, he was managing partner in strategy and planning and chief financial officer at Arthur Andersen, and he graduated from Fordham University in 1974.
During his first tenure as CEO, the company created Optum, its health services arm.
On returning, he pointed to the company's long-term growth objective of 13 to 16 percent.

sentences.text: UnitedHealth Group named Jodee Kozlak as its first chief administrative officer, effective September 28, 2026, a newly created role covering people, real estate, procurement and corporate security, with CEO Stephen Hemsley citing her experience in strategy, organizational development and governance.

Robert "Bobby" Hunter, previously CEO of UnitedHealthcare government programs, became president of UnitedHealthcare days later, while Tim Noel remains the unit's CEO, with Hunter focused on the insurer's modernization agenda.
Heather Cianfrocco announced her departure in March 2026.

sentences.text: UnitedHealth Group is the largest US private health insurer, with 2025 revenues of $447.6 billion, up 12% year over year, and UnitedHealthcare serving 49.8 million consumers.
Optum diversifies the group beyond insurance across care delivery, data and pharmacy services, generating $270.6 billion of 2025 revenue and supporting more than 123 million consumers.

sentences.quote: Third-quarter earnings from operations increased from $4.3 billion in the prior-year period
sentences.text: A margin recovery is under way: third quarter 2026 operating earnings rose to $6.6 billion from $4.3 billion, and the medical care ratio improved to 88.4% from 89.9%.
Management is deliberately shrinking to repair profitability, guiding 2026 revenue above $439.0 billion, a 2% decline reflecting planned right-sizing.
Guidance has been raised twice in 2026, to at least $19.50 reported and $20.50 adjusted earnings per share.
